roofs.note: e_roof_N = log2(N)/256 < 1 because N < 2^256. Deficit is ~1e-41 — must use Decimal; float64 rounds to 1.0.

hierarchy: log2(N-2^n)/256 .. log2(N-2^(n-1))/256 — unsolved mirror window band

correlations.note: e_q sits just under e_roof_N; deficit from 1 is Decimal-scale (~1e-41). float64 cannot distinguish e_roof_N from 1.0 for powering.

P135.note: q = N-d unknown; use e_q_window_low..high as mirror exponent band right under e_roof_N

ruling: e_roof_N = log2(N)/256 is the true near-1 scalar ceiling. e_q = log2(N-d)/256 is the solved mirror height and sits in the mirror exponent band under e_roof_N. Direct shells n/256 are range-height warps, not the order roof.
